callees.name: resolve_model_backend
callees.pre_condition: The runtime configuration has been initialized.
callees.post_condition: Returns a non-empty string identifying the configured CLI backend.

callees.name: _normalize_backend
callees.post_condition: Returns the canonical backend name corresponding to the given alias. Unrecognized aliases are returned unchanged.

callees.name: _compose_stdin
callees.pre_condition: prompt is a non-empty string. files is a list of string file paths (possibly empty).
callees.post_condition: Returns a single string composed from the prompt text and file paths, formatted as subprocess standard input for the CLI backend.

callees.name: cli_effort
callees.post_condition: Returns the configured reasoning effort level as a non-empty string.
